section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the demographic data collection procedures and the systematic scale translation methodology used to adapt four scales into Portuguese. Participants provided demographic information including sex, age, ethnicity, education, and self-reported height and weight (used to calculate BMI). The translation process followed a five-step guideline involving independent translators, back-translation, expert committee review for semantic/idiomatic/experiential/conceptual equivalence, and pre-testing with bilingual participants. The text mentions the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and SATAQ-3 as scales that required items to be rewritten in the affirmative.
